title: Multiple Endings: Trigger Conditions and Player Path Guidance
subtitle: A deep dive into crafting multiple ending triggers and player path guidance systems. By quantifying core elements, we define clear completion thresholds, build a tiered hint system ranging from strong to no guidance, and design dynamic feedback to balance exploration freedom, helping developers efficiently construct multi-ending narrative structures.

breakdown.title: How to Write Ending Trigger Conditions
bullets: Break conditions into: main story progress + key choices + collection/achievement thresholds
Avoid over-hiding: ensure at least 1–2 endings are reachable by 'playing normally'
Make conditions explainable: let players know exactly what they're missing, rather than relying on pure luck

breakdown.title: Hint Intensity Tiering (Critical)
bullets: Weak hints: environmental details/line dialogue hints (suitable for hardcore exploration)
Medium hints: task logs/encyclopedia progress (suitable for general audiences)
Strong hints: explicit 'you will miss a storyline' warnings (protects experience)

breakdown.title: Player Path Guidance
bullets: Use 'milestones' to tell players: this line is X steps away
Provide retry costs: chapter rewind/save points, rather than restarting the whole game
Ending differences must be obvious: gameplay mechanics/levels/rewards must change in at least one aspect
